forms.detail: AIHW: nicotine, the active ingredient of tobacco, can be tobacco-derived or synthetic.
AIHW names cigarettes (manufactured and roll-your-own), cigars and pipes (Australia).

AIHW: electronic cigarettes ('e-cigarettes'), or vapes, are personal vaping devices designed to deliver nicotine; common e-liquids include propylene glycol, vegetable glycerol and flavourings and may contain nicotine in freebase or salt form; the terms 'vapes' and 'e-cigarettes' are used interchangeably.
AIHW: snus is a smokeless tobacco product; oral nicotine pouches are similar to snus in appearance but typically do not contain tobacco, containing nicotine with flavourings and other ingredients.
AIHW refers to nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) available through general practitioners (Australia).
